findings.text: non-blocking: `assert delay <= INTERVAL` cannot fail, because the arm runs ten one-second sweeps so any observable delay is at most nine against a sixty-second bound; only total starvation fails it, at :361, so the fragment's 'composed within the interval' claim is not measured.

non-blocking: `set(gated.passes) <= set(ungated.passes)` holds whatever the gate does, because the ungated arm passes on all ten sweep indices (asserted at :354) and the gated arm can only index the same ten; the assertion cannot detect a pass the base would not have made.

non-blocking: the pass record is written whenever the gate was due, including after the compose at :3077 raised into the handler at :3085-3086, so a transient failure is not retried until the 60 s interval expires or an input moves, where the ungated sweep retried on the next sweep.
